The mariner project folders

Source: R/setup.R
mariner_dirs.Rd

The single source for every default path in the package. Returns the three directories mariner works in, as a named list:

Usage

mariner_dirs(root = NULL)

Arguments

root

Project root. NULL (the default) resolves it with mariner_project_root().

Value

A named list of three absolute paths: assets, reports, zips.

Details

assets

assets/ – the Quarto extension, assembled once by mariner_setup_project(). Every render stages the theme from here, so a batch of fifty reports unpacks it once.

reports

reports/ – the .qmd sources, their PDFs, and a copy of _extensions/. The extension has to sit beside the documents: xelatex resolves the font paths in brand-preamble.tex against the directory that holds the .tex. An extension one level up gives a document that finds its format and then dies with "the font Lora-Regular cannot be found".

zips

zip_files/ – the bundles you hand out.

The paths come back whether or not the directories exist. mariner_setup_project() and .onAttach() create them.

See also

mariner_setup_project(), mariner_project_root()

Examples

mariner_dirs(root = tempdir())
#> $assets
#> [1] "/private/var/folders/k3/k8hfzfxd11j6vy0_t2rx27yw0000gn/T/RtmpDjwOKV/assets"
#> 
#> $reports
#> [1] "/private/var/folders/k3/k8hfzfxd11j6vy0_t2rx27yw0000gn/T/RtmpDjwOKV/reports"
#> 
#> $zips
#> [1] "/private/var/folders/k3/k8hfzfxd11j6vy0_t2rx27yw0000gn/T/RtmpDjwOKV/zip_files"
#> 

# Every default path in the package is composed from this:
mariner_dirs(root = tempdir())$reports
#> [1] "/private/var/folders/k3/k8hfzfxd11j6vy0_t2rx27yw0000gn/T/RtmpDjwOKV/reports"
